description: True-positive candidates for the experimental shape-based param heuristic (#544). With the default-OFF flag they pass through as `untouched` — these entries serve as the seed corpus for measuring the heuristic's lift when the flag is enabled in test mode. Each value is long (>16), high-entropy (>4.0 for base64; >3.5 for hex; UUID-shape always), and the key matches one of the suspicious-prefix patterns (`*_id`, `*clid`, `*_token`, `*_uid`, `*_session`).

entries.notes: #544 shape positive: matches *clid prefix, long base64. With flag ON, this becomes `cleaned` to https://example.com/. (Avoids `click_id` because that name is already in TRACKING_PARAMS and would strip flag-OFF.)
#544 shape positive: matches *_uid prefix, long hex. With flag ON, `cleaned` to https://example.com/.
#544 shape positive: matches *_id prefix, long base64. With flag ON, `cleaned` to https://example.com/.
#544 shape positive: matches *_uid prefix, UUID shape. With flag ON, `cleaned` to https://example.com/.
#544 shape positive: matches *_session prefix, long base64. With flag ON, `cleaned` to https://example.com/.
#544 shape positive: matches *_token prefix (NOT in allowlist — `partner_token` is not an oauth/session key), long base64. With flag ON, `cleaned` to https://example.com/.
